<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-23. -->
## YouTube Music

- **Playback source inspector:** Touch and hold the three-dot Menu in expanded Now Playing to see which audio and video streams Music is reading. A normal tap still opens the stock menu. The inspector distinguishes a downloaded song from the audio and video tracks of a saved video, and shows the selected format numbers (itags). **Unconfirmed** means the reader could not verify the source; it does not mean network playback. This applies to RVX stream downloads, not exported device files.
- **Stream downloads:** With client spoofing enabled, Music now keeps the local stream when playing a usable RVX download. Tracks without a usable copy retain normal online playback.
- **Add to queue in tap order:** On Music 9.15.51, 9.40.51 and 9.45.51, enable **RVX → Player → Add to queue in tap order** to play manual additions before the original Up next list resumes. Duplicates are kept, **Play next** still jumps the line, and shuffled, Cast and Jam queues keep their stock behavior.

Verified on a Moto Edge Plus 2023: Music 9.40.51 reported saved audio and video separately while online, and cleared the cached labels on an uncached control. Queue ordering and duplicate additions were verified on Music 9.45.51.

Refresh the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch YouTube Music and install the resulting app.
